feedback.summary: Well done on your Great Barrier Reef monitoring concept and thorough Week 10 Gantt plan with STK chosen. Your writing is clear and structured. Your preliminary technical progress is currently weak with no results yet, so focus next on analysis, formal requirements, and referencing to stay on track.
